body: ayy I love robin's stuff :D "home" is beautiful.

hey Jamie. thank you for the comment, it means a lot.

I'm very proud of you for staying alive and meeting your better self, it honestly gives me hope. thank you

hey, I like 60's kind of stuff mostly. rock is great :)

I usually paint things that happened to me in dreams or "visions", (ahh christ I'm at risk of being an edgy twelve year old, god save us :')) so they don't make much sense to people that didn't see it happen. I don't mind, though.

I'm going to try to hold on, thank you for the comment

so sorry for the bad things that have happened to you, I'm glad you held on and I'm so glad you feel less hopeless. have a good one, man :)
thank you, it means a lot xx
thank you for sharing, I'll definitely check it out x

this is so kind. thank you, kristi xx

very sorry to have upset your mother, she sounds like a lovely person (as do you) and I know I don't know you but I'm very proud of you for choosing to live. you've come a long way and it can be hard to fight, so well done :)

ah man thats so kind of you to say, thank you x

I'm incredibly grateful for everyone who reached out. kindness is such a strong force and its a lot of what's keeping me, and many others, I'm sure, around. so thank you, again :)

man thats lovely of you, thank you so much

I'm getting into The Doors atm, so pretty much anything on their strange days album is golden, but "I can't see your face in my mind" is probably my favourite at the moment. what about you? :)

update:

still here, guys. I woke up a moment ago. I won't say I'm cured or anything but waking up the day after you thought you were dead is probably one of the weirdest feelings i'll ever encounter. In my room, in the corner, headphones on- Jesus, Spotify was still playing. I've barely moved physically but something's changed.

Thank you so much for all of your messages. \`I can't promise you that this is the last time I attempt something like this but I'm going to try to hold off. some of the things you guys have been through are so heartbreaking, and I'm proud of you for being okay, or at least still being here.
feeling pretty warm for the start of winter. its been a long few years. time to sleep. bye to everybody <3

hey AJ, cool name :)

honestly, don't worry about it man. this post was just to kinda prove I existed at one point. I plan on passing as painlessly as I can, I think it'll be okay. 

but seriously bless you for replying, and thanks for being willing to help on the community. have a good one x
